actions.action: Merge low-load flights, announced at least 7 days ahead (passengers moved to other flights)

decisions.message: Kestrel update: The FAA and our engine maker have asked all airlines to inspect a part on one engine type as a precaution. Some of our aircraft use this engine. No Kestrel aircraft has had a problem with this part. Inspections start this week and may take some aircraft out of service for a short time. If a check affects your flight, we will text you with your options at least 24 hours ahead. Safety comes first, always. Questions? Reply HELP or open the app.
decisions.why:
Passengers saw the TikTok video before they heard from us.
Say what is known and what is not; promise only notice, not outcomes.
Cheapest action on the menu so the message can go out.

customer_mix._note: TEAM ASSUMPTION, share of Kestrel passengers by group (no public split: research section 5 [GAP]). Dossier: 'Price-conscious travelers: families visiting relatives, students, vacationers, and some small business travelers' plus agencies booking group tickets. Families first (holiday season, Christmas week 97% booked), vacationers next, students on winter break, 'some' business, agencies small but each books a whole group. Shares are passengers, not bookings. Each persona weighs its group's share split evenly over that group's personas.
